knowledge:
- key_parameters: object=A GRanges object containing the peak calling results or RBP binding sites ;; annotation=Path to a GFF3 annotation file downloaded from GENCODE (required for most profiling functions) or a GRanges object (for windowProfile) ;; include_intron=Logical; if TRUE, calculates relative position in the genomic feature including introns (recommended to be FALSE for polyA+ data) ;; group=Character; the metadata column name in the input GRanges object used to group and compare multiple conditions ;; exlevel=Numeric/integer; specifies which GENCODE level to exclude from the annotation ;; extranscript_support_level=Numeric vector; specifies which transcript support levels to exclude (use 6 to exclude NA) ;; split=Logical; if TRUE, splits the metagene profile into 5'UTR, CDS, and 3'UTR separately ;; maxLength=Numeric; filters introns by maximum length in intronProfile ;; minLength=Numeric; filters introns by minimum length in intronProfile ;; motif=Character; IUPAC motif sequence (e.g., "DRACH") to check for enrichment in motifProfile ;; genome=Character; name of the BSgenome package containing the genomic sequence (e.g., "BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10") ;; flanking=Numeric; size of the window around the peak center to check for motifs or splice sites ;; fraction=Logical; if TRUE, changes the y-axis of the motif profile from frequency to fraction ;; bin=Numeric; bin size for splice site profiling
- alternatives: windowProfile should be preferred over metaGeneProfile, intronProfile, and exonProfile when working with non-human/non-mouse species or customized annotations that are not in the GENCODE GFF3 format.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have CLIP-seq peak coordinates (or RNA modification sites) and want to understand their spatial distribution, enrichment, and sequence context across different transcript regions, splice junctions, or gene types.
- pitfalls: Setting include_intron = TRUE for polyA+ data is not recommended ;; Attempting to use GENCODE-specific profiling functions (metaGeneProfile, intronProfile, exonProfile, geneTypeProfile, spliceSiteProfile) with non-GENCODE or non-human/mouse GFF3 files will fail ;; When excluding transcript support level NA using extranscript_support_level, you must use the integer 6 instead of NA ;; For motifProfile, the correct BSgenome package for the target species must be installed and loaded in advance.

workflows.name: transcript_feature_profiling
workflows.intent: Profile and visualize CLIP-seq peaks across standard transcript features (metagene, introns, exons, gene types, and splice sites) using GENCODE GFF3 annotations.
workflows.stages: 1. Load peak data and GFF3 annotation ;; 2. Generate metagene profile using metaGeneProfile ;; 3. Generate intron profile using intronProfile ;; 4. Generate exon profile using exonProfile ;; 5. Generate gene type profile using geneTypeProfile ;; 6. Generate splice site profile using spliceSiteProfile
workflows.code:
testpath <- system.file("extdata", package = "cliProfiler")
test <- readRDS(file.path(testpath, "test.rds"))
test_gff3 <- file.path(testpath, "annotation_test.gff3")
meta <- metaGeneProfile(object = test, annotation = test_gff3)
meta[[1]]
library(ggplot2)
meta[[2]] + ggtitle("Meta Profile 2")
meta <- metaGeneProfile(object = test, annotation = test_gff3, include_intron = TRUE)
meta[[2]]
test$Treat <- c(rep("Treatment 1",50), rep("Treatment 2", 50))
meta <- metaGeneProfile(object = test, annotation = test_gff3, group = "Treat")
meta[[2]]
metaGeneProfile(object = test, annotation = test_gff3, exlevel = 3, extranscript_support_level = c(4,5,6))
meta <- metaGeneProfile(object = test, annotation = test_gff3, split = TRUE)
meta[[2]]
intron <-  intronProfile(test, test_gff3)
intron[[1]]
intron[[2]]
intron <-  intronProfile(test, test_gff3, group = "Treat")
intron[[2]]
intronProfile(test, test_gff3, group = "Treat", exlevel = 3, extranscript_support_level = c(4,5,6))
intronProfile(test, test_gff3, group = "Treat", maxLength = 10000, minLength = 50)
exon <- exonProfile(test, test_gff3)
exon[[1]]
exon[[2]]
geneTP <- geneTypeProfile(test, test_gff3)
geneTP[[1]]
geneTP[[2]]
SSprofile <- spliceSiteProfile(test, test_gff3, flanking=200, bin=40)
SSprofile[[1]]
SSprofile[[2]]
spliceSiteProfile(test, test_gff3, flanking=200, bin=40, exlevel=3, extranscript_support_level = 6, title = "Splice Site Profile")

workflows.name: custom_window_profiling
workflows.intent: Profile CLIP-seq peaks against customized genomic annotations or non-model organism annotations stored in a GRanges object.
workflows.stages: 1. Load peak data and custom annotation ;; 2. Extract target features (e.g., exons) into a GRanges object ;; 3. Run windowProfile to calculate relative positions and generate the profile plot
workflows.code:
testpath <- system.file("extdata", package = "cliProfiler")
test <- readRDS(file.path(testpath, "test.rds"))
test_gff3 <- file.path(testpath, "annotation_test.gff3")
library(rtracklayer)
test_anno <- rtracklayer::import.gff3(test_gff3)
test_anno <- test_anno[test_anno$type == "exon"]
window_profile <- windowProfile(test, test_anno)
window_profile[[1]]
window_profile[[2]]

workflows.name: motif_enrichment_profiling
workflows.intent: Analyze and visualize sequence motif enrichment around the center of CLIP-seq peaks using a reference genome.
workflows.stages: 1. Load peak data ;; 2. Run motifProfile specifying the IUPAC motif, reference BSgenome, and flanking window size
workflows.code:
testpath <- system.file("extdata", package = "cliProfiler")
test <- readRDS(file.path(testpath, "test.rds"))
motif <- motifProfile(test, motif = "DRACH",
    genome = "BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10",
    fraction = TRUE, title = "Motif Profile",
    flanking = 10)
motif[[1]]
motif[[2]]
